title: Phone Input
content: Build phone input with international support. Country selector: dropdown with flag and dial code. Auto-format: format number based on country pattern. Validation: validate phone format per country. Default country: detect from IP or browser locale. Search: search countries in dropdown. Display: show formatted number as typed. Mobile: numeric keyboard with inputmode.

variants.simple: Create phone number input with country code selector and formatting.
variants.detailed: Build phone input with international support. Country selector: dropdown with flag and dial code. Auto-format: format number based on country pattern. Validation: validate phone format per country. Default country: detect from IP or browser locale. Search: search countries in dropdown. Display: show formatted number as typed. Mobile: numeric keyboard with inputmode.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive international phone input. Country selector: dropdown or modal with flag emoji/icon, country name, and dial code (+1, +44, etc.), search/filter functionality, grouped by region optionally. Library: use libphonenumber-js for parsing, formatting, and validation. Auto-formatting: format as user types according to country pattern ((555) 123-4567 for US, +44 20 7123 4567 for UK). Validation: validate number format per country rules, check is-possible and is-valid, show specific error ("Number too short", "Invalid format"). Default country: detect from browser locale (navigator.language), IP geolocation API, or explicit default prop. Input attributes: inputmode="tel" for numeric keyboard, type="tel", autocomplete="tel". Display format: national format in input, international format when needed (+1 555 123 4567). Example number: show placeholder with example format for selected country. Country change: revalidate and reformat number on country change. Single input option: parse country from +XX prefix automatically. Flag icons: use country flag emoji or flag-icons library. Popular countries: show recently used or popular countries at top of list. Phone verification: optional "Send code" button for OTP verification flow. Clear formatting: store E.164 format (+15551234567) for backend, display formatted. Validation timing: validate on blur, show error after interaction. Mobile UX: bottom sheet for country selector, adequate touch targets.
